Module com.hft.systems.affinity
Package com.faster.affinity.exceptions

Class ErrorCodes

java.lang.Object
com.faster.affinity.exceptions.ErrorCodes
public final class ErrorCodes extends Object
Comprehensive error code constants and descriptions for the affinity library. Organized hierarchically with severity levels and recovery guidance.
